title: Microsoft MAI Trains 3T Parameter Model Entirely In House
summary:
Mustafa Suleyman announced that the development team has finished the initial training phase for the MAI-Base-2 artificial intelligence model. This foundation model belongs to the 3T parameter weight class and was created using only internal resources at Microsoft's MAI division.

Suleyman described the model as state-of-the-art and noted that the training process remained clean throughout the full run due to refined recipes and scaling ladders. The company will release post-training results shortly and has already published technical details in a blog post.
